items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Studs Terkel’s book The Good War has an interview with him

ctx.x: He also said the band worked on the same bill as other well-known performers. Do you have any . . .?
Pearlman changed his name to Waxman. If you want to check up on him, Studs Terkel’s book The Good War has an interview with him, and Waxman starts talking about me.
